resources.string: Run a one-shot code review with a CLI installed on your SSH host. These are real coding agents, not model-provider aliases. No automatic installation or Android CLI support is claimed.
Not configured: the DeepSea project and protocol have not been identified. It is not assumed to mean DeepSeek.

Select an SSH workspace in Workspace settings first. Install the chosen CLI and authenticate on that host; credentials are not copied from app providers. A non-interactive SSH shell must find the CLI on PATH.
Review the current project and explain potential bugs.
I trust this SSH host and its CLI configuration, and allow sending this request and project content to its model provider.

Review-only flags are used; app shell approvals do not govern external agents. Host configuration, hooks or MCP servers may have additional permissions. Use a dedicated restricted host account. No edit or permission-bypass mode is offered.
Another request is still running. Wait for it to finish.
Request disconnected. The remote process may still run; inspect the host before retrying. Leaving this page also disconnects a running request.
Results are temporary and are not inserted into chat. Review calls may incur provider charges. Maximum wait: 10 minutes. Closing the connection does not guarantee remote process termination.
I inspected the host; no harness request is running
